correctness.rationale: On the stable branch the first-order equation tends to \(n_1^{\prime}+\phi n_1=-lpha c_3\sin(\omega t)\). Independent coefficient matching gives \(A=lpha c_3\omega/(\phi^2+\omega^2)\) and \(B=-lpha c_3\phi/(\phi^2+\omega^2)\); both cosine and sine residuals simplify exactly to zero. For \(\sigma=5,lpha=0.3,\omega=1\), independent recomputation gives \(\phi^2+1=9.39473319220205\), matching the claimed correction factor. The primary PDF visually confirms the source inconsistency.
